title: Target Totals
commonMistakes: Forgetting to seed the prefix-count map with one empty prefix at total zero
Incrementing the current prefix count before looking up the complement
Treating the answer as a boolean and stopping at the first matching window
Building every window explicitly, which is quadratic and times out
followUps: How would you also return the shortest matching window?
What changes if every weight is guaranteed to be positive?
How would you answer the same question for a stream that never ends?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
